items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: because I wanted him to take Teddy Wilson's place

ctx.x: I said I am sure, and he said that's what I had in mind, because I wanted him to take Teddy Wilson's place. I said I'd sure hate it, and he said Rozelle Claxton is all right and that's what I said, we're sending your band and you're talking how I might have done that but if you were in a new area and didn't know anything, I would have gotten a piano player for you; He said, I wouldn't dare do like what you were talking about, but I was thinking that as a bandleader you need money all the time, and he said that I…

Hobart would have been there then. But to show you how he did think about Hobart, you see we're talking about 1939, well whatever date World War II was going on, Hammond was inducted and he did his boot training in Oklahoma, Camp Gruber, right out from Muskogee, which is not far from Tulsa. His mind was still on Hobart, trying to give Hobart a chance so he thought. He grabbed Hobart again and sent Hobart to Cafe Society in New York City, but Hobart just didn't have it as a singer. I'm like Hammond, I think Hobart…
